_doc: Race plane tuning (Harbour Run), loaded over config/flight.json for courses whose vehicle is "racer"; a key left out keeps the flight.json value. Faster than the stunt plane and built to bank hard: TOUCH_BANK/MAX_BANK go to ~80°, and TURN_COS_MIN 0.3 keeps the turn rate growing like tan(bank) up to ~72°, so a gentle bank barely turns and a steep one pulls 10 g. INDUCED bleeds speed in sustained hard turns. Touch uses the stunt plane's attitude stick (let go = wings level), which suits the level-flight air gates. WING_HALF is the model's half span for pylon hits.
